project.name: zx-rzx
project.description:
The RZX format: reading a recording (header, blocks, embedded snapshot, and frames with their fetch count and IN values), writing one, and replaying it against the emulator.
Brought over from the emulador-alu branch, where it had already been separated out to depend on nothing but emulator. What was left behind there stays behind here: RzxParser.loadSnapshot, which turned the embedded snapshot into a jspeccy SpectrumState. It was the only thing tying the format reader to jspeccy, and parsing never calls it.
This is now where the player is evolved; the other projects are meant to consume it from here rather than keep their own copy.
